decisions: Normalized whitespace in categorical columns (cleaned 5 padded values across 1 column(s)).
Removed 2 exact duplicate row(s) (indices: [17, 93]). Modeling dataset reduced from 301 to 299 records.
Preserved all legitimate domain outliers (luxury price points and high-mileage records) without automated trimming.
Formulated 'Car_Age' feature using reference year 2018 (range: [0, 15] years).
Designated 'Selling_Price' strictly as target (excluded from predictors). Excluded 'Car_Name' from baseline predictor matrix to prevent high-cardinality overfitting.

whitespace_normalization.policy: Stripped leading/trailing whitespace without merging distinct model categories or altering semantics.

deduplication.policy: Removed second instance of exact duplicate rows for modeling dataset to prevent train-test split leakage; original raw CSV remains unmodified.

outlier_handling_policy.Selling_Price_outliers: 17 statistical upper outliers (e.g. Land Cruiser, Fortuner) retained. These represent legitimate luxury vehicle depreciation dynamics.
outlier_handling_policy.Present_Price_outliers: 14 statistical upper outliers retained as valid high-tier vehicle listings.
outlier_handling_policy.Driven_kms_outliers: 8 upper outliers retained, including 500,000 km Activa delivery scooter. Not automatically dropped to preserve real-world mileage dispersion; robust/tree models handle without trimming.
outlier_handling_policy.policy: No automated outlier trimming applied. Retaining genuine market variation is essential for unbiased regression modeling.

feature_engineering.reference_year_rationale: Set to dataset max manufacturing year (2018) to prevent lookahead calendar bias and guarantee non-negative vehicle age.
feature_engineering.policy: Derives intuitive vehicle age metric (newer cars = low age, older cars = high age) for monotonic depreciation modeling.

exclusion_justification.Car_Name: High cardinality (98 distinct models in 299 rows). One-hot encoding creates excessive dimensionality (98 sparse columns), leading to severe overfitting. Showroom asset value ('Present_Price') serves as the continuous proxy for vehicle market segment.
exclusion_justification.Year: Fully captured with inverse sign by engineered 'Car_Age'. Including both would induce exact collinearity.

pipeline_blueprint.description: scikit-learn ColumnTransformer (StandardScaler on numericals + OneHotEncoder(drop='first') on categoricals)
pipeline_blueprint.anti_leakage_note: Pipeline is strictly unfitted. It will be fitted exclusively on training splits in Phase 4 modeling.
